`interface IResourcePlayback`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`AnimatedResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/animatedresourcedecoder/), [`VideoResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/videoresourcedecoder/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.playback` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IResourcePlayback.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/playback/IResourcePlayback.java)

The playback controls of an animated image or a video, to play, pause, seek and loop it.

## Description

Get them from [`Resource.getPlayback`](/reference/resources/resource/#Resource-method-getPlayback), or from a resource player node.
Times are in seconds; call the controls on the render thread.

## Learn more

- [Images and media](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/)

| [autoplay](#IResourcePlayback-property-autoplay) | `boolean` |  | If `true`, the playback starts by itself once the resource is loaded. |
